title: Simple Traveler Packs
description: Wearable backpack tiers with their own Back slot, storage, keybind opening, crafting recipes, and visible 3D models.
body:
# Simple Traveler Packs

Simple Traveler Packs adds wearable backpack tiers for Fabric. Each backpack has its own storage size, can be equipped in the Trinkets Back slot, can be opened with a keybind while worn, and renders as a visible 3D backpack on the player.

![Worn Backpack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9e8ed9f4b5175ce4ef1e4ffd73b41a3cec38b33_0.webp)

## Features

- Three backpack tiers:
  - Scout Pack — 9 slots
  - Traveler Pack — 18 slots
  - Expedition Pack — 27 slots
- Equip backpacks in the Trinkets Back slot
- Press **G** to open the equipped backpack
- Right-click a backpack in your hand to open it
- Items save inside each backpack
- Backpack nesting is blocked
- Each backpack has its own crafting recipe
- Each backpack has its own worn 3D model and texture

## Requirements

This mod requires:

- Fabric API
- Trinkets Updated

The mod is required on both the client and the server.

## Notes

Backpacks cannot be placed inside other backpacks. This prevents nesting exploits and keeps storage balanced.
